people.name: Abishai
people.line: David's nephew, one of his mighty men and commanders

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Bichri
people.line: Benjamite, father of the rebel Sheba

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your lord’s servants, and pursue after him, lest he get himself fortified cities, and escape out of our sight.”
translations.bsb: And David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom. Take your lord’s servants and pursue him, or he will find fortified cities and elude us.”
translations.kjv: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord's servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.
translations.asv: And David said to Abishai, Now will Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord's servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fortified cities, and escape out of our sight.
